notes.title: RICO Autumn Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29255966/2c6f21f4af6044ac62ab87024a9a39847077601e.png

The latest update for RICO adds two brand new modes, and fixes several issues that players have been experiencing with the game:

Hardcore Case Mode
Players now have access to a brand new variation on case mode. Hardcore case allows players to take their existing selection of unlocked weapons and equipment into a new case, but at a higher difficulty level affording them the ultimate RICO challenge.

Challenge Mode
Challenge mode is a whole new way to play RICO, with 27 levels (18 single player and 9 co-op) of intense goal-based action. Players will work against the clock to beat specific timed challenged within each level, pushing themselves and their skills to the limits.
Challenge mode also allows players to earn Reputation Points (RP) and unlock weapons skins in offline play for the very first time.
Changes and Fixes

-    Easier bomb defusal
-    Now easier to shoot enemies on stairs
-    Other small bug fixes

notes.title: Patch Notes - Bomb Timers!
notes.notes:
We have issued a patch for the game, notably it decreases the difficulty of late-game bomb-defuse objectives.


 Minimum bomb timers increased to ease difficulty on later case mode levels
 Performance improvements
 Fix to disappearing and non-interactable doors
 Fixed big with interaction with menus behind loading screen
 Fix to missing legs when downed for some characters
 Changes to speed up future patch iteration

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
We have released a hot-fix for the save game corruption issue that has been reported by a handful of players. We've rolled in a couple of small fixes to other areas of the game as well.

Patch Notes


Correctly handle corrupted save data file
Fix for Steam invite connection when launched from desktop
Optimised network message sizes to prevent rare disconnect in latter stages of Case Mode
Fix to incorrect material on car-park SUV
Experimental fix for Ultra Wide display support
Enabled operation data display on pause menu (for help when bug reporting)
